messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for auth-service — sustained microburst of token-refresh 5xx errors and anomalous outbound traffic to unknown S3 endpoints. Possible leaked log artifacts containing Authorization headers. Severity: P2. Paging oncall-auth.

carla: I'm oncall, taking this. quick plan: 1) freeze deploys 2) start key/service-token rotations for auth-worker 3) kick off token-revoke job 4) scrub suspected S3 objects with auth headers. I'll coordinate.

alice: seeing spike at ~11:32 UTC. /auth/refresh POST rate x120 normal, many 500s. Redis KV errors on auth-cache-1 replica in logs. Also seeing unusual PUTs to logs-bucket from a service principal.

ben: recommend immediate edge blocks for the three CIDR blocks we see in telemetry: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 192.0.2.128/26. Will push WAF rules and update firewall.

carla: ben — please apply WAF blocks and confirm. dave — can you stop new log forwarding to external sinks?

ben: WAF update in progress. Pushing rule set id: waf-auth-2026-03-17-blocks. ETA ~90s.


dave: paused log forwarders to external sinks and disabled the logging lambda that ships staging logs. Ran: 
```
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name ship-logs --environment "{\"Variables\":{\"ENABLED\":\"false\"}}"
```
Edge/nginx rules updated to drop from the three CIDRs.

carla: running revoke job now: `scripts/revoke_recent_refreshes --window 24h --service auth-worker` will push blacklist to auth-gateway.

alice: I launched scrub: `python tools/scrub_auth_headers.py s3://redwood-logs/prod/2026-03-17/ --pattern \"Authorization:\" --redact --dry-run=false` — found 42 objects with raw headers. Starting rewrite to redact tokens.

ben: suggest rotating KMS alias `alias/auth-enc` and create new key for re-encrypting any cached secrets. Avoid schedule-key-deletion until new key is in use.

dave: beginning controlled rotation for svc-account credentials used by auth-worker. Rolling restart of auth-workers with canary 10% then 50% then 100%. Use config flag `AUTH_KEY_ALIAS=new-key` for rollout.

elena: legal on standby. Need impact summary: number of customers with tokens present in leaked objects, types of PII and timeline of exposure. Please collect and DM with secure link.

support-bot: Created Support Incident INC-2026-348. Triage team notified. Customers with >0 token activity in last 24h: generating list now.

carla: draft external customer message (internal review) ready in #support-drafts. Do not send until we confirm PII.

alice: scrub completed for the 42 objects — all Authorization headers redacted, new copies uploaded with `-redacted` suffix and originals moved to quarantine-bucket for forensics.

ben: KMS key staged, re-encryption job scheduled. Not rotating user keys; rotating service keys only.

dave: canary restart successful for 10%. Auth 5xx spike trending down to normal. Token refresh error rate back to ~1.2x baseline.

carla: updating timeline and mitigation checklist. Next updates every 15m. Current actions done: WAF blocks applied, log forwarders paused, 42 objects scrubbed, service keys rotated, revoke job executed, support incident opened.

incident-bot: Incident recorded as IR-2026-0484. Actions: temporary tokens revoked, WAF blocks in place, scrub job completed, KMS rotation initiated. Tags: auth, potential-log-exposure, kms-rotate, customer-notice-pending. :white_check_mark:
